propositions: A Jira-removed parent is never cleared from local parent_id because fetcher omits the parent key when the peer has none and inbound_differ refuses to emit parent_id=None without evidence
An inbound parent clear requires positive proof that the peer once carried that parent to prevent clearing locally-set parents that were never pushed to the peer
The managed_refs gate alone cannot decide whether to emit a parent clear because it only answers whether the ref was created locally, never whether the peer ever had it
A fail-open parent-map read that returns {} must not overwrite a recorded peer-parent observation with 'no parent' or the next pass treats the degradation as a deletion and repeats the data loss
The design requires three-state parent read (unobserved key, observed-absent parent, resolved parent) rather than two-state to distinguish truncated reads from intentional deletions
Inbound parent clears must be gated on ADR-0026 per-binding baseline observation that persists the last-synced peer parent across reconcile passes
